exclusions.source_text: History of another malignancy with exceptions
Known active CNS metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis
Known human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), active hepatitis B or C infection
Childs-Pugh class B or C cirrhosis or any other clinically significant liver disorder
Clinically significant cardiovascular event within 6 months prior to start of NKT3964 treatment
Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) \<50% as measured by echocardiogram (ECHO) or multigated acquisition (MUGA) scan within 4 weeks prior to first dose
History of anthracycline-related cardiomyopathy regardless of recovery
Active cardiac conditions including myocarditis, pericarditis, or clinically significant valvular heart disease
